csv_scope_of_work: Town of Kilmarnock is requesting proposals for the purpose of contracting Professional Services to lead the review and update of the Town s Comprehensive Plan, along with the associated community engagement effort. The purpose of the Comprehensive Plan is to articulate a community vision for the next 20 years and to set out the specific goals, policies, and actions needed to achieve that vision. To develop this document, the selected consultant will review all relevant codes, ordinances, policies, and other relevant documentation; analyze the current demographics and projected future growth of Kilmarnock; develop and implement a robust community engagement program; and work closely with representatives of the Town Council, the Planning Commission, Town Administration, the Zoning Director, Business Owners, and the citizens of Kilmarnock.
